subject: POV: you finally ship after weeks of only thinking
script: POV: three weeks on your side project, and not one line of code. It feels like nothing happened. But you decided things. The name. The pricing model. What you're not building. That's not nothing. That's a paper ship: decided, not built yet. In Flayel, log them with the bird from any page, so the thinking leaves a trail. So when you finally sit down to build, every call you made is already waiting. Thinking weeks count. Try Flayel free at flayel dot com.
